title: MSCI’s new rules could squeeze Strategy’s Bitcoin buying machine
summary: MSCI approved rules threatening Strategy's index membership as its shares trade nearly 69% below their peak. On Oct. 15, the global index provider announced that it would adopt a new methodology excluding companies classified as non-operating businesses from its Global Investable Market Indexes.
